summary: Harmony Gold filed a Form 6-K disclosing an on-market sale of 3,000 ordinary shares by executive director H.E. Mashego at a volume-weighted average price of R284.0333 per share for a total value of R852,100.80 on 28 May 2026. This is a routine director dealing disclosure, not a forced or abrupt departure, board change, or special-situations event. The filing is a standard report of insider trading under JSE rules. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural terms are provided. What to watch: no risk-arb angle; this is a non-event.
